description: Find an owned transaction by transactionId, list all, or AND untagged where predicates. Legacy id lookups and tagged selectors remain accepted; continue legacy cursors with the same selector. Search matches description or merchant substrings. Periods require startDate, endDate and timezone. Pages contain 1-1000 rows (default 500); totalCount counts all matches. Money uses { amount, currency }: exact decimal magnitude plus CREDIT/DEBIT direction. operationType is raw; category carries provider and normalized values. Unknown/generic PURCHASE codes add no classification; known category labels can. Conflicting signals have no economic type; mixed vehicle tax/fee labels are not guessed. statementId links are included. Mofi stores POSTED when status is missing. For the same user, connection, and account, reimports with the same provider ID update the existing row; no prior versions are retained. Distinct IDs are not linked or deduplicated as pending-to-posted transitions. Pass page.nextCursor unchanged.

mode.description: findOne requires transactionId (legacy id accepted instead); query requires where; findAll accepts page.
